description: Xi’an University of Science and Technology publishes 70,948 annotated images of underground coal-mine drilling sites. Five object classes cover grippers, chucks, miners, safety helmets and drill pipes. Images were collected with intrinsically safe recording equipment, cleaned, annotated and checked by experts; labels use PASCAL VOC format. ScienceDB assigns CC BY 4.0 for free reuse. The acquisition dates and complete list of mine locations are not established in the inspected metadata. These images can validate perception components in simulations of drilling operations and safety monitoring. They do not directly measure failure probabilities, and transfer to different lighting or equipment remains uncertain. No directly related catalogue record was found.
